```yaml
name: Ampcode PR Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    branches: [main, staging]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: ampcode-pr-review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ampcode_review:
    if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.draft }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      matrix:
        index: [0, 1, 2]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Ampcode CLI
        run: npm install -g @sourcegraph/amp

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed_files
        run: |
          echo "changed_files<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          git diff --name-only ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }} ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} \
            | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|py|java|go|rb|php|c|cpp|cs|kt|kts|swift|rs)$' \
            | head -n 50
          echo EOF >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Write changed files to file
        run: |
          echo "${{ steps.changed_files.outputs.changed_files }}" > changed_files.txt

      - name: Run Ampcode review (index ${{ matrix.index }})
        env:
          AMPCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AMPCODE_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          files=$(awk "NR%3==${{ matrix.index }}" changed_files.txt | tr '\n' ' ')
          if [ -z "$files" ]; then
            echo "No files to review for index ${{ matrix.index }}."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Reviewing files: $files"
          amp review \
            --files "$files" \
            --pr ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} \
            --repo ${{ github.repository }} \
            --github-token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} \
            --api-key ${{ secrets.AMPCODE_API_KEY }} \
            --output json
```
